"raw_response": "# FILE: Chart.yaml
apiVersion: v2
name: multi-tier-app
description: A Helm chart for a production-grade multi-tier application with frontend, backend, and Postgres
type: application
version: 0.1.0
appVersion: "1.0.0"
---
# FILE: values.yaml
global:
  imagePullSecrets: []
  podAnnotations: {}
  nodeSelector: {}
  tolerations: []
  affinity: {}

frontend:
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: nginx
    tag: "1.25.5"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  containerPort: 8080
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 80
    annotations: {}
  env: []
  config:
    # Override to a full URL if needed; default is computed to internal backend service
    apiBaseUrl: ""
    additional: {}
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "100m"
      memory: "128Mi"
    limits:
      cpu: "500m"
      memory: "256Mi"
  podAnnotations: {}
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10001
    runAsGroup: 10001
    fsGroup: 10001
  containerSecurityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    capabilities:
      drop:
        - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    timeoutSeconds: 2
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /readyz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    timeoutSeconds: 2

backend:
  replicaCount: 2
  image:
    repository: ghcr.io/example/backend
    tag: "1.0.0"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  containerPort: 8080
  service:
    type: ClusterIP
    port: 8080
    annotations: {}
  env: []
  config:
    logLevel: info
    additional: {}
  secret:
    # Arbitrary application secret used by the backend (e.g., JWT signing)
    create: true
    existingSecret: ""
    secretKey: APP_SECRET
    value: "change-me-in-production"
  database:
    port: 5432
    # If set, use this secret for DB credentials; expected keys:
    # POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD, PGHOST, PGPORT, DATABASE_URL
    existingSecret: ""
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "200m"
      memory: "256Mi"
    limits:
      cpu: "1"
      memory: "512Mi"
  podAnnotations: {}
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 10002
    runAsGroup: 10002
    fsGroup: 10002
  containerSecurityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
    capabilities:
      drop:
        - ALL
  livenessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /healthz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    timeoutSeconds: 2
  readinessProbe:
    httpGet:
      path: /readyz
      port: http
    initialDelaySeconds: 5
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 3
    timeoutSeconds: 2

postgres:
  image:
    repository: postgres
    tag: "16.3"
    pullPolicy: IfNotPresent
  service:
    port: 5432
    annotations: {}
  auth:
    # If set, use existing secret for credentials (keys: POSTGRES_DB, POSTGRES_USER, POSTGRES_PASSWORD)
    existingSecret: ""
    database: appdb
    username: app
    password: "change-me-in-production"
  persistence:
    enabled: true
    accessModes:
      - ReadWriteOnce
    size: 20Gi
    storageClass: ""
  initdbScripts: {}
  podAnnotations: {}
  podSecurityContext:
    runAsNonRoot: true
    runAsUser: 999
    runAsGroup: 999
    fsGroup: 999
  containerSecurityContext:
    allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
    readOnlyRootFilesystem: false
    capabilities:
      drop:
        - ALL
  resources:
    requests:
      cpu: "250m"
      memory: "512Mi"
    limits:
      cpu: "2"
      memory: "1Gi"
  livenessProbe:
    exec:
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT"
    initialDelaySeconds: 20
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 6
    timeoutSeconds: 5
  readinessProbe:
    exec:
      command:
        - sh
        - -c
        - pg_isready -U "$POSTGRES_USER" -d "$POSTGRES_DB" -h 127.0.0.1 -p "$PGPORT"
    initialDelaySeconds: 10
    periodSeconds: 10
    failureThreshold: 6
    timeoutSeconds: 5
---
# FILE: templates/secret-db.yaml
{{- if and (not .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret) (not .Values.backend.database.existingSecret) -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "**********-db-credentials" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
type: Opaque
stringData:
  POSTGRES_DB: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.database | quote }}
  POSTGRES_USER: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.username | quote }}
  POSTGRES_PASSWORD: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.password | quote }}
  PGHOST: {{ printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" | quote }}
  PGPORT: {{ printf "%v" .Values.postgres.service.port | quote }}
  DATABASE_URL: {{ printf "postgresql://%s:%s@%s:%v/%s" .Values.postgres.auth.username .Values.postgres.auth.password (printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-") .Values.postgres.service.port .Values.postgres.auth.database | quote }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/secret-backend.yaml
{{- if and .Values.backend.secret.create (not .Values.backend.secret.existingSecret) -}}
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-backend-secret" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
type: Opaque
stringData:
  {{ .Values.backend.secret.secretKey }}: {{ .Values.backend.secret.value | quote }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-frontend-config" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
data:
  APP_NAME: {{ .Chart.Name | quote }}
  API_BASE_URL: {{ default (printf "http://%s-backend:%v" .Release.Name (.Values.backend.service.port | int)) .Values.frontend.config.apiBaseUrl | quote }}
{{- range $k, $v := .Values.frontend.config.additional }}
  {{ $k }}: {{ $v | quote }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-backend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-backend-config" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
data:
  LOG_LEVEL: {{ .Values.backend.config.logLevel | quote }}
  PORT: {{ printf "%v" .Values.backend.service.port | quote }}
  DB_HOST: {{ printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" | quote }}
  DB_PORT: {{ printf "%v" .Values.postgres.service.port | quote }}
{{- range $k, $v := .Values.backend.config.additional }}
  {{ $k }}: {{ $v | quote }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/configmap-postgres.yaml
{{- if .Values.postgres.initdbScripts }}
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-postgres-init" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
data:
{{- range $fname, $content := .Values.postgres.initdbScripts }}
  {{ $fname }}: |
{{ $content | indent 4 }}
{{- end }}
{{- end }}
---
# FILE: templates/service-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-frontend" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  annotations:
{{- if .Values.frontend.service.annotations }}
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.service.annotations | indent 4 }}
{{- else }}
    {}
{{- end }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.frontend.service.type }}
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: {{ .Values.frontend.service.port }}
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
---
# FILE: templates/service-backend.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-backend" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
  annotations:
{{- if .Values.backend.service.annotations }}
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.service.annotations | indent 4 }}
{{- else }}
    {}
{{- end }}
spec:
  type: {{ .Values.backend.service.type }}
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: {{ .Values.backend.service.port }}
      targetPort: http
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
---
# FILE: templates/service-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
  annotations:
{{- if .Values.postgres.service.annotations }}
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.service.annotations | indent 4 }}
{{- else }}
    {}
{{- end }}
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: {{ .Values.postgres.service.port }}
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
---
# FILE: templates/service-postgres-headless.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-postgres-hl" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
spec:
  clusterIP: None
  ports:
    - name: postgres
      port: {{ .Values.postgres.service.port }}
      targetPort: postgres
      protocol: TCP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-frontend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-frontend" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.frontend.replicaCount }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 25%
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: frontend
      annotations:
{{- if or .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.frontend.podAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml (merge (dict) .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.frontend.podAnnotations) | indent 8 }}
{{- else }}
        {}
{{- end }}
    spec:
{{- if .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.imagePullSecrets | indent 8 }}
{{- end }}
      securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.podSecurityContext | indent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: frontend
          image: "{{ .Values.frontend.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.frontend.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.frontend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: {{ .Values.frontend.containerPort }}
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ printf "%s-frontend-config" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
          env:
{{- range .Values.frontend.env }}
            - name: {{ .name }}
              value: {{ .value | quote }}
{{- end }}
          securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.containerSecurityContext | indent 12 }}
          resources:
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.resources | indent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.livenessProbe | indent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.frontend.readinessProbe | indent 12 }}
      nodeSelector:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.nodeSelector | indent 8 }}
      tolerations:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.tolerations | indent 8 }}
      affinity:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.affinity | indent 8 }}
---
# FILE: templates/deployment-backend.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-backend" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
spec:
  replicas: {{ .Values.backend.replicaCount }}
  revisionHistoryLimit: 5
  strategy:
    type: RollingUpdate
    rollingUpdate:
      maxUnavailable: 0
      maxSurge: 25%
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: backend
      annotations:
{{- if or .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.backend.podAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml (merge (dict) .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.backend.podAnnotations) | indent 8 }}
{{- else }}
        {}
{{- end }}
    spec:
{{- if .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.imagePullSecrets | indent 8 }}
{{- end }}
      securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.podSecurityContext | indent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: backend
          image: "{{ .Values.backend.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.backend.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.backend.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: {{ .Values.backend.containerPort }}
              protocol: TCP
          envFrom:
            - configMapRef:
                name: {{ printf "%s-backend-config" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- if .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
{{- else if .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
{{- else }}
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ printf "%s-db-credentials" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
{{- if .Values.backend.secret.existingSecret }}
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ .Values.backend.secret.existingSecret }}
{{- else if .Values.backend.secret.create }}
            - secretRef:
                name: {{ printf "%s-backend-secret" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
          env:
{{- range .Values.backend.env }}
            - name: {{ .name }}
              value: {{ .value | quote }}
{{- end }}
          securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.containerSecurityContext | indent 12 }}
          resources:
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.resources | indent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.livenessProbe | indent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.backend.readinessProbe | indent 12 }}
      nodeSelector:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.nodeSelector | indent 8 }}
      tolerations:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.tolerations | indent 8 }}
      affinity:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.affinity | indent 8 }}
---
# FILE: templates/statefulset-postgres.yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: StatefulSet
metadata:
  name: {{ printf "%s-postgres" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
    app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
    app.kubernetes.io/component: database
spec:
  serviceName: {{ printf "%s-postgres-hl" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
  replicas: 1
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
      app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
      app.kubernetes.io/component: database
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: multi-tier-app
        app.kubernetes.io/instance: {{ .Release.Name }}
        app.kubernetes.io/component: database
      annotations:
{{- if or .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.postgres.podAnnotations }}
{{ toYaml (merge (dict) .Values.global.podAnnotations .Values.postgres.podAnnotations) | indent 8 }}
{{- else }}
        {}
{{- end }}
    spec:
{{- if .Values.global.imagePullSecrets }}
      imagePullSecrets:
{{ toYaml .Values.global.imagePullSecrets | indent 8 }}
{{- end }}
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 60
      securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.podSecurityContext | indent 8 }}
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: "{{ .Values.postgres.image.repository }}:{{ .Values.postgres.image.tag }}"
          imagePullPolicy: {{ .Values.postgres.image.pullPolicy }}
          ports:
            - name: postgres
              containerPort: {{ .Values.postgres.service.port }}
              protocol: TCP
          env:
{{- if .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.postgres.auth.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
{{- else if .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ .Values.backend.database.existingSecret }}
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
{{- else }}
            - name: POSTGRES_DB
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ printf "%s-db-credentials" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
                  key: POSTGRES_DB
            - name: POSTGRES_USER
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ printf "%s-db-credentials" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
                  key: POSTGRES_USER
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: {{ printf "%s-db-credentials" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
{{- end }}
            - name: PGPORT
              value: {{ printf "%v" .Values.postgres.service.port | quote }}
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql/data
{{- if .Values.postgres.initdbScripts }}
            - name: initdb
              mountPath: /docker-entrypoint-initdb.d
{{- end }}
          securityContext:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.containerSecurityContext | indent 12 }}
          resources:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.resources | indent 12 }}
          livenessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.livenessProbe | indent 12 }}
          readinessProbe:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.readinessProbe | indent 12 }}
      volumes:
{{- if .Values.postgres.initdbScripts }}
        - name: initdb
          configMap:
            name: {{ printf "%s-postgres-init" .Release.Name | trunc 63 | trimSuffix "-" }}
{{- end }}
  volumeClaimTemplates:
    - metadata:
        name: data
      spec:
        accessModes:
{{ toYaml .Values.postgres.persistence.accessModes | indent 10 }}
        {{- if .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass }}
        storageClassName: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.storageClass | quote }}
        {{- end }}
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: {{ .Values.postgres.persistence.size }}",

url: Add an api key '--bc-api-key <api-key>' to see more detailed insights via https://bridgecrew.cloud
